record.issue_text: The wildcard zod schema in parseRefreshTokenResponse doesn't actually work as a wildcard, so expiry_date is never validated in sync mode

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` attempts to express “any key with a number value” via object literal computed keys: `{ [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), ... }`. Zod `z.object({...})` does not support wildcard/dynamic keys this way; it will instead define a single literal property whose name is whatever `z.string().toString()` returns (not a real wildcard). As a result, in “sync mode” (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`) the schema will not validate `expiry_date` (or any actual expiry field) as intended, and will likely fail parsing unless the response contains that exact literal key.
